sections.title: Use of Proceeds
sections.excerpt:
Use of Proceeds: We will not receive any proceeds from the resale of
    shares of our Common Stock by Roth Principal Investments pursuant to this prospectus. We may receive up to $50,000,000 in aggregate
    gross proceeds under the Purchase Agreement from any sales of shares of our Common Stock we make to Roth Principal Investments pursuant
    to the Purchase Agreement after the Commencement. We intend to use any net proceeds that we receive under the Purchase Agreement
    for the development of our product candidates, working capital and general corporate purposes. It is possible that we will not issue
    any shares under the Purchase Agreement. See “Use of Proceeds.” Conflict of
    Interest: RCP, an affiliate of Roth Principal Investments,
    is deemed to have a “conflict of interest” within the meaning of the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority, Inc. (“FINRA”)
    Rule 5121
